== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: the image of [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (PNG, published 24 January 2025, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c50a10bd8ab021c415be20d693881d9b2f485423/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.png holotable c50a10b]) and the image of [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (GIF, published 24 January 2025, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/f8913a9b3f8485a741cd7db63a6dcf7b066a6085/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/tatooineobiwanshut_ai.gif holotable f8913a9]). Same area (x 0–260, y 540–745: the lower left corner with the lightsaber icon and the “(AI) E1” mark) cropped from each published image and enlarged 2× without smoothing; left: before (PNG), right: after (GIF). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
